The '''sonic emitter''' was a type of anti-wildlife device used during the [[Jedi Civil War]] by [[Caal Jordan]] on [[Hrakert Station]]. This device was designed to emit a powerful sonic pulse. It was very useful for scaring off or stunning various wildlife. The emitter proved lethal for the several species of [[Firaxan shark/Legends|Firaxan sharks]] patrolling the waters near the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] secret [[Hrakert Station]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].

Normally it would have a very limited range, but in underwater environments such as on Manaan the signal would be amplified. The weapon was designed to be attached to an [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]], and used when wildlife go too close. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] found one in the station and it proved to be a vital piece of equipment in order for him to reach the [[Star Map]] on the ocean floor.

Sonic emitters were also used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] to repel wildlife from supply routes.
